jobs.title: Senior Embedded Android Engineer- Hardware
jobs.description: Team description SumUp's Hardware Development team builds the physical products millions of small businesses rely on every day, and this role sits right at the start of a new chapter: moving our in-house hardware onto the Android platform for the first time. This isn't a typical Android device, it's a highly customised, security-first product built from scratch, which means the person joining will help define how the operating system, drivers, and secure processor come together rather than inheriting someone else's setup. The team works closely with hardware, software, and QA engineers across the bring-up process, so this role offers a rare chance to shape a product's foundations while working alongside experienced embedded and secure processor leads. Please note this role would require relocation to Berlin, Germany. You'll work closely with Engineers, Product, Design, Compliance, Risk, and Operations, giving you the opportunity to influence solutions well beyond your own team. If you enjoy solving complex backend problems, working in a highly collaborative environment, improving reliability, and building scalable capabilities that enable other teams to move faster, this could be an exciting opportunity to make a real impact at SumUp. jobs.description: About Wolt At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. We run it for private households employing a cleaner, nanny, or caretaker, and for businesses that manage employment relationships at scale. The customer stays the legal employer — quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, and handles social insurance, taxes, and filings on their behalf, automated end to end. Where everyone else sells software, quinn sells the outcome. We hold the power of attorney for every customer, take decisions, do the work, and take legal responsibility for the result. The purpose behind it is simple: Fair employment. For all. That means making correct and fair employment simple and accessible for any employer and any employee, in any market quinn enters. Where we stand Thousands of clients rely on us. Last year alone, over CHF 200 million ran through our platform. We are at CHF 7 million ARR and growing. The Swiss business is profitable. We have acquired two new businesses in the last twelve months. A hungry team of over 50 people (and 5 dogs) in offices in Switzerland, Germany and the United Kingdom. And we are raising our next round. We do not have a finance function yet. We have an external accountant, a signed audit, and a CEO and COO who know exactly what they need to run this company — but cannot build it alone. That is the opening. We’ve learned that scammers are impersonating Commvault team members—including HR and leadership—via email or text. These bad actors may conduct fake interviews and ask for personal information, such as your social security number.  

What to know:

  • Commvault does not conduct interviews by email or text.
  • We will never ask you to submit sensitive documents (including banking information, SSN, etc) before your first day.
  • Commvault recruiters may contact prospective candidates through LinkedIn and other professional networking platforms regarding career opportunities. If you are unsure whether a recruiting communication is legitimate, review the profile to ensure they have a badge verifying them as a Commvault employee.

Een eerder (kort) onderzoek leverde verwarrende resultaten op waarbij de verbanden tussen verwachting en omzet niet duidelijk te zien waren. We hebben echter de bevestiging dat vergelijkbare onderzoeken in andere landen wel gelukt zijn. Het is dus waarschijnlijk dat we hier nog zaken gemist hebben. Dit is jouw eerste uitdaging! Vervolgens ga je op zoek naar antwoorden op de volgende vragen: Hoe kunnen we deze data zo beschikbaar maken dat externe onderzoekers hier optimaal nut uit kunnen halen? Wat vinden belanghebbende op dit gebied hiervan? Hoe kunnen we intern deze verbanden inzetten om verdachte opgaven in andere enquêtes en bronnen te detecteren?

jobs.title: Senior Embedded Linux Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Auterion builds a cutting-edge operating system for autonomous robotic systems that empower a diverse range of platforms to perform surveillance, reconnaissance, inspection, mapping and logistics tasks. Our industry-leading software drives the adoption of robotic fleets and is recognized by the U.S. government as the future standard for its drone programs. 

We are looking for a Senior Embedded Linux Software Engineer taking on tasks within the AuterionOS ecosystem, from writing applications to adding driver support for new peripherals, maintaining system services and optimizing performance on embedded platforms. You will be working closely with:

  • Linux running on embedded hardware
  • C/C++, Python & Bash codebases
  • Engaged and friendly engineers from across Auterion

Responsibilities

  • Work within the Board Support team and collaborate with other development teams to build leading-edge products.
  • Add features, solve bugs, write tests and improve the performance of software components running on AuterionOS, Auterion’s custom embedded Linux distribution.
  • Collaborate with engineering and product teams to understand both internal and customer use cases.
  • Propose new software solutions and take ownership of the implementation. Your technical expertise will have a huge impact on bringing Auterion’s drone products to market.
  • Provide expert support (L3) to customers

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Auterion, you will play a pivotal role in the successful development, integration and deployment of Auterion-powered drone systems. 

In this role, you will collaborate closely with the production, hardware engineering, and firmware/software teams, as well as operations, ensuring that every platform transitions smoothly from an airframe concept into a fully validated flying robot ready for deployment. You will serve as the primary technical interface for partners, work closely with them to understand their technical requirements, configure and adapt existing solutions, contribute to core software development, and ensure successful implementation. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys combining hands-on technical work with customer collaboration and system-level problem solving, bridging the gap between hardware, firmware, and real-world flight performance. 

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Operate in a highly hands-on environment with evolving system requirements, rapidly iterating across hardware and software integration challenges.
  • Manage software releases and perform firmware flashing and configuration using PX4 or adjacent autopilot ecosystems, including sensor calibration, ESC tuning, and system bring-up.
  • Provide deep avionics and airframe expertise, including autopilot tuning, sensor and payload integration, power systems and airworthiness consider

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Lead
jobs.description: Ben jij ready voor Change? Bij Change zoeken we een Talent acquisition Lead die recruitment naar een hoger niveau brengt. Je werft zelf actief mee en bent daarnaast de senior op de afdeling: je coacht junior recruiters, brengt structuur aan in de dagelijkse operatie en helpt het team groeien in eigenaarschap, kwaliteit en resultaat. Daarmee maak je meteen helder: dit is geen gewone recruiterrol, maar een combinatie van zelf doen, richting geven en mensen beter maken . Hier ga je werken: Bij Change kom je terecht in een energieke en snelgroeiende organisatie waar ontwikkeling, samenwerking en beweging centraal staan. We werken voor bekende merken zoals Marktplaats, Odido en Eneco en zorgen iedere dag voor de beste klantbeleving. Onze organisatie groeit hard en recruitment speelt daarin een belangrijke rol. We zoeken daarom iemand die zelf stevig in de werving staat, maar ook het recruitmentteam verder helpt ontwikkelen. Je werkt nauw samen met teamleads, management, HR en collega-recruiters. Je krijgt veel verantwoordelijkheid, ruimte om mee te denken en de kans om zichtbaar impact te maken op de groei van Change. Waar ben je verantwoordelijk voor? Actieve sourcing en hunting Je zoekt actief naar commercieel talent via LinkedIn, jobboards en netwerken. Je weet latent werkzoekenden te vinden en te enthousiasmeren voor Change. Coaching en ontwikkeling van het recruitmentteam Je begeleidt en coacht recruiters in sourcing, selectie, stakeholdermanagement en kandidaatcommunicatie.

jobs.title: Stagiair Social Media - vtwonen
jobs.description: Amsterdam – Ben jij altijd online en heb je een passie voor wonen, interieur en social media? Tijdens deze allround stage werk je mee aan de online kanalen van vtwonen, vtwonen Landelijk en vtwonen Design en ontwikkel je jezelf binnen een professioneel mediateam. Location: Maastricht, Aachen, and Eindhoven region, working mainly on-site with our development partner in Maastricht. Regular travel to Hamburg and to clinical sites, about 2 to 4 days per month.

About the venture: ROB'E

ROB'E is a Hamburg-based medtech startup and part of the NLC Health Ventures portfolio. We are developing a robotic system that holds and steers a standard transesophageal echocardiography (TEE) probe during structural heart interventions. Interventionalists get stable, reproducible echo views, and echocardiographers no longer have to stand next to the patient in the X-ray field.

Our first-generation prototype has been used in a first-in-human study with published results. We are now developing the next generation from scratch as a fully compliant medical device for CE marking and FDA clearance. The team includes a CTO, a System Software Architect and a Head of Quality & Regulatory.

You are the mechatronic design authority of ROB'E.
